explication: Vulkan-Hpp is a header-only C++ binding layer for Vulkan, adding safer types, STL-friendly interfaces, exceptions, and RAII resource handles. Its principal runtime workflow is application code using generated headers to configure Vulkan resources and issue API operations; the repository also includes XML-driven generators and a broad RAII sample suite demonstrating rendering, device discovery, debugging, and advanced features. Edges are limited to relationships visible in the README or supplied excerpts/index references; many sample stages are represented by directory paths because their individual source was not sampled.
